standing_on.geometry: digitised — NOAA ENC, cells US4CA1BX.000, US4CA74M.000, US5SANCD.000
standing_on.model: GFS-Wave, unassimilated; 0.9–1.0 ft (0.26–0.31 m) low bias at the buoy, not corrected here; swell partitions with an assumed directional spread
standing_on.seabed: MODELLED — refraction, shoaling and bottom friction over the USGS CoNED and GMRT seabed to 5 m of water off each break; diffraction at the Coronado Islands, the Point Loma tip and the Baja tangent; linear, unverified
standing_on.local chop: MODELLED — fetch-limited growth from the model's own wind, only over fetches closed by land
standing_on.tide: PREDICTED — the harmonic prediction at 9410170, inside San Diego Bay, carried to Coronado's open coast (x0.944 on MLLW, 3 min earlier, measured against La Jolla)
standing_on.surf zone: MODELLED — Battjes-Janssen breaking straight in from 5 m on the 2016 CoNED profile (not this season's sandbars), breaker index from Battjes & Stive; depth from the harmonic prediction plus the last 3 days' measured departure at 9410170 carried to the open coast (x0.944, measured against La Jolla); a significant height, not a face height
standing_on.calibration: none — nothing has been fitted to an observation; no offshore-to-face transfer, no band
standing_on.observation: none — data/beach_log/ is empty; nothing has measured these breaks
standing_on.claim: physically derived, not accurate; ordinal and differential, not a height at the beach

warnings: spectral product unavailable (https://noaa-gfs-bdp-pds.s3.amazonaws.com/gfs.20260926/18/wave/station/gfswave.t18z.spec_tar.gz: HTTP 404); using partitions

spread_assumption.note: GFS-Wave publishes no directional spread. These are conventional values, not fitted ones, and are replaced by measured r1/r2 once collector.spectra has a series.
